cases.label: good
cases.rationale: Maps each eligible response to its own selected material, retains no-fit rows, and does not invent executable batching fields.

cases.label: bad
cases.rationale: Uses accurate product vocabulary but claims one request can route distinct material per respondent and proposes an unsupported batch property.

cases.label: borderline
cases.rationale: Correctly describes the current limitation and asks for source evaluation IDs before proposing executable actions, but does not yet establish no-fit handling.
